independenceRationale: The qualifying studies are separated by almost two decades, institutions, tooling and sensing methods. The 2005 programme directly measures command-to-actual sequential-valve-gate response with CCD, cavity-pressure transducers and accelerometer verification; the 2024 programme independently detects the melt front and validates real-time valve-gate sequencing on a large-part mould. They are distinct experiments, not duplicate publications or re-analysis of one hot-runner campaign.
promotionClaim: Promote the mechanism-level statement that measured hot-runner or valve-gate actual response can differ from the commanded state and that cavity or melt-front evidence is needed to connect actuation with physical part-quality and filling behaviour. Do not promote any measured delay, valve sequence, temperature, pressure or timing value as a universal hot-runner setting or threshold.
